title: Synthetic example: The Lantern on the Steps

lantern.plan: A single scene about a lantern left on a library step. Introduce no state changes or invented facts about tracked characters.
lantern.draft:
The library had closed an hour ago, but someone had left a lantern on the steps. Its light made a small, steady circle in the rain.

Beside it lay a book wrapped in a blue scarf. A note slipped between the pages read: Keep the light on. I know the way back.

The scarf was dry underneath. Whoever had left it had tucked the corners carefully around the book. A second note, smaller than the first, said: There is room for two under the awning.

Across the street, the last bus pulled away. Footsteps sounded at the far end of the pavement. The lantern stayed where it was.
